name: Pension Holzknechthof
beschreibung:
Overview

The Antik Wellness Pension Holzknechthof is run by the Holzknecht family and is also known under the name "Hotel zum Holzknecht". It is located at Franz-Senn-Straße 170 in the district of Milders of the municipality of Neustift im Stubaital, centrally yet in a quiet setting. A total of 28 beds in 12 rooms are available, offered as single, double and multi-bed rooms. Directly next to the house is an approximately 2,000 m² swimming lake filled with so-called Granderwasser, complemented by a sunbathing lawn of about 4,000 m². The guesthouse combines a personal atmosphere with an extensive wellness and leisure offering and is about 150 m from the ski and hiking bus stop.

History/Background

The name Holzknechthof refers to the Holzknecht family, who run the house on their own website and welcome their guests there. The character of the accommodation includes three historic parlours as well as a new parlour with a farmhouse stove. In addition to the guesthouse, the family runs its own apartment house. Exact founding or renovation years are not documented in the sources consulted and are therefore not mentioned here.

Arrival

Milders is located in the Stubaital in the municipality of Neustift im Stubaital and can be reached from the direction of Innsbruck via the road through the valley. The ski and hiking bus stop is about 150 m from the house. Sufficiently spacious parking spaces are available directly in front of the house. The ski areas Stubaier Gletscher, Schlick 2000, Elferlifte and Serleslifte can be reached by car or by public transport; the starting point of the cross-country ski trail is also nearby.

Tips

The house includes a wellness area with sauna, steam bath, planetarium, Kneipp and plunge pool, whirlpool and relaxation area; massages are available on request for an extra charge. Directly at the guesthouse there is an in-house lift together with a practice lift with night skiing and a magic carpet, supplemented in winter by its own ice rink for ice skating and ice stock shooting. Mountain bikes are lent out free of charge, and the starting point of the mountain bike trail network begins right at the house. The restaurant Holzknecht Bräu and "Draxl's Stubn" are about 150 m away, as are a supermarket and a daytime and cellar bar. In the winter season there is live music every Thursday from 20:30, in the summer season every Friday from 20:30. For children there is a playground, children's pool, trampoline, bouncy castle, volleyball and a flying fox.

Best time to travel

The Stubaital can be enjoyed all year round. In winter, the ski areas around the Stubaier Gletscher, the practice lift with night skiing directly at the house and four toboggan runs, one of which is illuminated at night, are the main attractions. In summer, hiking and swimming in the in-house health lake are the focus. From 20 December to 18 April, bookings are only possible from Saturday to Saturday. A general opening time valid all year round is not documented.
